notes_zh:
- **修复** OCR 识别逐行排版的图片（梗图、诗歌、清单等）时换行丢失、整段文字粘连的问题（macOS 26 的 Markdown OCR 路径）
- **优化** 「OCR 转 Markdown」开关不再要求先开启图片 OCR，它同样作用于「粘贴 OCR 文字」
- **优化** 图片条目的「重新识别」在图片 OCR 关闭时也可用，便于刷新旧的识别结果
- **优化** 设置分区标题「图片 OCR」更名为「OCR」
notes_en:
- **Fix** OCR losing line breaks on line-structured images (memes, poems, lists) — text came out glued into one string on the macOS 26 Markdown OCR path
- **Improve** The "OCR to Markdown" toggle no longer requires background image OCR to be enabled — it also governs "Paste OCR Text"
- **Improve** "Recognize again" is now available for image clips even with image OCR off, so stale OCR results can be refreshed
- **Improve** Settings section title renamed from "Image OCR" to "OCR"

beta.notes_zh:
- **修复** 快捷面板在浅色外观下叠深色窗口时背景发灰、文字对比度差的问题：面板背景改回外观锁定的系统材质方案（同时移除上一版的「快捷面板背景」设置项）
- **修复** 点击面板外部关闭时偶发的窗口闪烁，以及焦点被拉回旧应用而不是落在所点应用的问题
- **修复** App 图标恢复为原扁平样式
- **优化** 窄窗口下用 Tab/方向键切换分类时，选中的分类标签自动滚动到可见区域
- **优化** ⌘K 快捷操作菜单换用更通透的材质背景
beta.notes_en:
- **Fix** Quick Panel turning gray-washed with poor text contrast in light appearance over dark windows: the panel backdrop is back on the appearance-locked system material (the "Quick Paste background" setting from the previous beta is removed)
- **Fix** Occasional window flicker when dismissing the panel by clicking outside, and focus being pulled back to the previous app instead of the one you clicked
- **Fix** App icon restored to the original flat style
- **Improve** In narrow windows, switching filters via Tab/arrow keys now auto-scrolls the selected tab into view
- **Improve** The ⌘K command palette uses a more translucent material background
